additional_context: FHIR-24099 was the broader duplicate pharmacy-resource definition review, while FHIR-25538 was the MedicationAdministration-specific clone. Later Published issue FHIR-32960 intentionally clarified the vaccine boundary by removing the opening "and vaccines" phrase and directing vaccine administration to Immunization while allowing MedicationAdministration for workflow reasons with an equivalent Immunization instance; that later change is already reconciled on the combined branch by b7214bc5256739e402b4118bf12c9492f9291cbd.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active MedicationAdministration narrative is already correct after considering both FHIR-25538 and the later FHIR-32960 clarification.
